title: Striking the Rider Premium Standing Owed When a Rider is Suspended
content:
Memorandum of the premium accounting desk on the arrears figure struck when one of the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders is put into premium suspension.

## 1. The figure

The rider premium standing owed when a rider is put into premium suspension is the rider premium charged that is struck, less the money struck against it, less the credits struck, rounded to the nearest cent and never less than nothing.

## 2. The days of grace that govern the span

The days of grace that govern the span the figure is struck over are the days of grace the rider held allows; this bears on the span alone and not on whether the days of grace have run out.

## 3. The span itself

The days of grace that govern are reckoned into whole months at thirty days to the month, any part month being dropped, and the span runs back over that many whole calendar months from the handling date, an entry posted in an earlier calendar month falling outside it; where no days of grace govern, the span is empty and no entry falls inside it.

## 4. The three sums struck

**The rider premium charged that is struck** is every rider premium charge posted to the rider premium account.

**The money struck against the figure** is every payment posted to the rider premium account.

**The credits struck** are every credit posted to the rider premium account.

## 5. The figure taken

The figure taken is the one the rider record shows standing owed.

## Worked through on hypothetical inputs

A rider premium account carries charges of 46.90 USD in each of three calendar months, one payment of 46.90 USD and one credit of 10.00 USD, and the rider record shows 83.80 USD standing owed.

1. Struck over every entry on the account, the rider premium charged comes to 140.70 USD, the money struck against it to 46.90 USD and the credits struck to 10.00 USD.
2. Those three give 140.70 USD less 46.90 USD less 10.00 USD, that is 83.80 USD, and the figure is never less than nothing.
3. The figure taken is the one the rider record shows standing owed, **83.80 USD**, rounded to the nearest cent.

Every figure above is a hypothetical input.
